installationStatus: Technical distribution series. Complete-million-entry SwiftData import, device memory and app interaction performance have not been accepted. Do not require users to install or sort 64 dictionaries manually.

exclusions: All examples, quotations, media files and audio URLs are excluded. 468 pure-symbol, braille or punctuation records normalize to an empty identity and are enumerated separately. No ordinary word or phrase is silently truncated.
contentReview: Generic community dictionary contains rare, obsolete and sensitive vocabulary. Licensing verification is not correctness or child-suitability review. Regional IPA mapping is not independently quality-assured.
